### Reproduction

Run generation token by token, then use the list of output tokens somewhere in the middle as input_ids along with past_key_values.
For instance this prompt "随机生成三个运动员的得分记录，以jsonl格式输出为三行，每个字典包括运动员名字name，项目event，得分score。" gives something like this:
```
{"name": "Li Na", "event": "Tennis", "score": 98.5}
{"name": "Usain Bolt", "event": "Sprint", "score": 9.58}
{"name": "Simone Biles", "event": "Gymnastics", "score": 16.75}
```
But when you manually concat the exact tokens generated for 'Li Na' after '{"name": "', the response turns into an introduction of her:
```
{"name": "Li Na, a Chinese tennis player, has won 10 Grand Slam singles titles. The number of Grand Slam singles titles won by the top 10 players in the world is ...
```
I use the basic forward pass and greedy decode the output logits:
```
        forward_kwargs = {
            "input_ids": current_input_ids, # may include multiple tokens
            "past_key_values": past_key_values,
            "return_dict": True,
            "use_cache": True,
        }
        with torch.inference_mode():
            outputs = model(**forward_kwargs)
        next_token_logits = outputs.logits[:, -1, :]
        next_token = torch.argmax(next_token_logits, dim=-1)
```

### Expected behavior

## Source Code
https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/d64a6d67d8c004a25570db4df5689e06caea6af7/src/transformers/models/qwen3_5/modular_qwen3_5.py#L345
When a past_key_values cache is present and input_ids contain multiple tokens, the recurrent state is always reset, causing loss of context.

## Possible Fix
My current fix is reusing the recurrent_state in the cache (initial_state=recurrent_state) but not reusing the conv_state. However, this fix only gives a reasonable output, it does not guarantee the same output as when you run the model token by token.
To be frank I'm not sure if this fix really makes sense, but it does work better than what is present now.

comments.body: A more reasonable fix would be to modify the forward function within Qwen3_5GatedDeltaNet to handle multiple tokens with past token by token.

So I consulted the Qwen3.5 team and the fix is simple: skip the seq_len==1 check, as it's just a safety check in transformers.
He told me that transformers currently does not officially support mtp or similar features, so I guess this may not be planned. But, would it be better to give some instruction instead of letting the logits run wild?

Anyways, hope the solution helps!

title: transformers modular_qwen3_5.py: Recurrent states always reset when using cache and seq_len>1
